title: TwoTurtles Funny Mod
description: Funny Things Like many explosions laughs, fun, and MANY MORE
body:
Currently Neoforge only, but I may also make it for fabric
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This mod add many fun features to test like...

### Creeper Potion,
Creeper Enchantment (maces only),
### New Mobs,
   Linky,
### New Items,
### And many more!
===============================================================================

Note: This Mod is for Neoforge 1.21.8 ONLY and requires neoforged to be installed on the client side.

THIS IS MY FIRST MOD EVER FOR JAVA!!!!

Tutorial
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To use the creeper enchantment enchant a mace with the enchantment and smack an enemy with it to watch them fly into the air.

To use the creeper potion drink it or splash it to get launched. (this could be used for pvp)
